needs_human.note: The behaviour is as described: ShareSendQueue.swift:451-452 catches every ShareAPIError on /complete (including .transport(.notConnectedToInternet) and .cannotConnectToHost) and goes to pollForFile (line 461). byPath errors are swallowed by try? (line 533), so the loop runs for the whole window (at least 120 s) and ends in .unknown. Neither .stopped(.cannotReach) nor localNetworkDenied is applied there, unlike init and chunk (outcome(for:) at line 542 and line 511). Whether this is a defect depends on whether the spec's 'unanswered /complete' includes unreachable transport errors; I6 can be read both ways (the request may have reached the server before the link dropped). The spec text does not settle it, so the human should decide.
